target_frequency_scope: 3.5 GHz vicinity; use only in a specifically authorized laboratory or other approved arrangement

design.pilot: one route per cell for variance and workflow review; pilot data excluded from final holdout
design.sample_size_rule: Recalculate after the pilot using observed between-route variance and a predeclared precision/power target; five routes are a planning floor, not a statistical guarantee.
design.split_rule: Keep entire routes and measurement batches in exactly one of development, validation, or final holdout. Never split adjacent samples across partitions.

scenarios.purpose: obstruction loss and link margin changes

safety_and_compliance_gates: Confirm the specific frequency, emission, antenna, power, place and time are authorized by the relevant radio authority or approved lab.
Use type-approved equipment where applicable; do not connect or transmit with an unverified SDR.
Before any UAV work, verify registration, operator requirements, airspace status and operation approval for the actual aircraft, site and task.
Use receive-only or shielded-lab alternatives if outdoor emission authorization is unavailable.
No flight, RF emission, or device control is performed by this project software.
can_validate: specified link budget under documented conditions
